title: Adjust feed hides its controls; Save can never be enabled
detail: From Pen feeding, Adjust feed shows only the pig table. The Adjustment panel (mode, %, end date, note) sits below a 297px sheet body with overflow hidden; "Complete the required fields first" floats unpadded at the left edge. Fix: let the sheet body grow or scroll to the panel.

title: "Edit" on a done pen opens a sheet with nothing editable
detail: A01's row trails "Edit" (verb: correct a posted record). Tapping it opens the pen sheet: "Nothing left to do", a disabled Record items, no correction. Fix: show the plain chevron until the correction decision (tasks-built-79) is made.

title: Chinese "公猪·母猪" calls piglets boars and sows
detail: Boars · gilts reads 公猪·母猪 on the Piglets card and counts sheet; 母猪 is also the pen header's word for the sow (1头母猪). A farmer reads breeding boars and sows. Fix: 小公猪·小母猪 in strings.js.

title: Feed plan screens have no Chinese
detail: inspection-astra-concept has no zh strings or language switch, so Pen feeding, Adjust feed and Feed plan are English-only and Chinese fit cannot be checked. Fix: move feed copy into the strings registry with zh.

title: Every drawer has both a header X and a footer Back
detail: Pen sheet, fewer piglets, death, boars and gilts, weight, set count and More actions each show X and Back that do the same thing. Two controls, one act; the verbs give Back and Close different meanings. Fix: keep the footer Back only.

title: Move asks about treatments the pen record already answers
detail: Moving from A03, where Dock tail is done for all 12, still asks "Had tail docking? No / Yes". Fix: ask only about treatments partly given in the source pen; fill the rest from the record.

title: "Tagged 1 of 12" on a breeders-only farm implies 11 owed
detail: On a farm that tags breeders only, the Piglets card still reads Tagged 1 of 12 next to Breeders kept 1. The fraction suggests 11 untagged piglets. Fix: under the breeders scheme drop the Tagged fact; Breeders kept says it.

title: Tag piglets is both a tool button and a day item
detail: A03's sheet offers Tag piglets in the tool row and as the Day 3 item ("Not filled · 0 of 12 tagged"); both open the same list. Fix: show the tool only once the ID item is done or absent.

title: End task states "9 not done" three times
detail: Summary says "3 of 12 pens done" and "9 pens not done"; the group header repeats "Not done · 9 pens". Fix: keep "3 of 12 pens done" and the group title; drop the other two counts.

title: Three phrasings for one pen-allocated feed state
detail: Pen feeding row: "Follow curve"; pig Feed plan: "Included in pen allocation"; walk tag: "Included in daily feed". One state, three words. Fix: one string used on all three screens.

title: "Unchanged" filled badge on every row before any change
detail: Each pig row shows Current → New with identical values and a filled "Unchanged" badge; the law says status words are coloured text with a dot, never filled badges. Fix: show New and its status only once a change exists.

title: "Ad-lib" said twice in one card
detail: The Grower 1 card shows Ad-lib as the meta on the right and again as the Daily feed value. Fix: drop the meta; the value says it.

title: Dates appear in three formats across one pen
detail: Pen log groups by weekday (Thu, Wed, Sun), day cards say "Planned 10/08", the list says "10/09" or a bare time. The worker cannot match a log line to a day card. Fix: one format, weekday plus date.

title: Pen header and pen row are two doors to one sheet
detail: Each pen is a group whose header ("A02 · 1 sow ›") and only row both open the same sheet: two targets, two chevrons per pen. Fix: one row per pen, carrying the pen code.

title: Hint asks for a number that is already filled
detail: The tag is prefilled (001217) yet the disabled reason reads "Add the number and the sex". Only sex is missing. Fix: the hint names only what is missing ("Pick boar or gilt").

title: "Use 12" is not a registered verb
detail: The fewer-piglets sheet's primary reads "Use N"; strings.json has no Use, and nothing is recorded until the pen's Record. Which word?
options: "Tick 12" (Tick: choose subjects, nothing recorded until Record)
recommendation: "Tick 12": an existing verb with exactly this meaning.
